items.title: Write an automation
items.summary: How to write a folder the chat can run on a schedule. Already in Jasiri.

items.title: Find anything by describing it
items.summary: Photos, videos, and documents on your phone are transcribed and indexed. Search them in plain language, like “the receipt from the plumber in March”.

items.title: Media tagger and organizer
items.summary: Detect what belongs to which project or course and file it for you. A student’s whiteboard photos and lecture recordings, sorted by course and searchable. An engineer’s project media, grouped by project.

items.title: AI-aware file manager
items.summary: A file manager the agent understands and can work with, while you stay in control.

items.title: Notes and to-dos, Obsidian compatible
items.summary: Plain Markdown notes that follow you everywhere. The agent can read and write them if you let it.

items.title: Video transcoder
items.summary: Shrink HD videos without visible quality loss. Phones have no SD cards now, and cloud plans have limits.

items.title: Backups
items.summary: Back up the folders you choose to somewhere you choose.

items.title: Learning labs
items.summary: Programming, Linux, and networking labs, installed in one tap. Practice from your pocket between classes.

items.title: Local AI models
items.summary: Run smaller AI models on the phone for jobs that do not need a frontier model.
